note: Resolution order: (1) the override whose prefix is the longest match of the model id; (2) the family whose match word appears as a whole word in the model id (case-insensitive, so claude-opus-5-6, opus and claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 all work); (3) 'default', with ONE warning. Families are data: add one entry to 'families' (here or in ~/.claude/team/prices.local.json, which is merged over this file) and nothing else changes. New versions of a known family need no change. cache_write_5m is 1.25x input, cache_write_1h is 2x, cache_read is 0.1x. Long-context and fast-mode surcharges are not modelled.
